summary: Continued the close-all-open-2026-09-22 plan's final DoD checklist: (1) live-browser-proved all three B28 reload behaviors (orchestration rule edit+reload, document-added-by-reload renders, concept-added-by-reload is usable) via a real ScrapForAI routine against an ad hoc app -- PASSED, screenshots+assertions green; (2) ran the full run-all-gates.ps1 -IncludeReleaseGate -IncludePaperwork sweep, which came back red on 5/6 gates, then spent the rest of the session diagnosing and fixing what was fixable.
nextStep: Two fixes are drafted/triaged but blocked by Claude Code's own safety classifier (refuses edits to security-sensitive files, no explanation given) -- need the user to apply them directly or grant explicit permission: (1) BusinessUiEmitterEmptyStateXssTest.everyRemainingInnerHtmlAssignmentOnlyClearsItsContainer needs to allow a legitimate sanitizeRichText-routed rich-text widget (exact diff described in chat transcript, not on disk); (2) 13 new hits in scripts/quality/security-pattern-sweep-allowlist.json need entries added, all triaged as near-certain false positives (schema-derived SQL identifiers spliced from the compiled model/fixed constants, one pure regex false-match on a UI widget name constant, PreparedStatement-bound params). After those: commit the 5 modified + 1 new file already on disk (git status is dirty, nothing committed this session), then re-run the full sweep to see residual state -- betaRelease and weeklyPaperwork will still fail regardless (betaRelease needs a full multi-script release-evidence pipeline run, out of scope for a dev session; weeklyPaperwork needs origin/main merged, branch is 54 commits ahead past the 50-commit threshold).
blocked: Claude Code's own safety classifier refused two edits (BusinessUiEmitterEmptyStateXssTest.java, security-pattern-sweep-allowlist.json) with no explanation -- both fully analyzed and ready, see NextStep.
verified: generator gate's ModelChangeClassifierTest (2 tests): green after fix, confirmed via targeted gradlew :generator:test --tests. check-dialect-methods-are-asked.py: green after removing 2 stale allowlist entries, confirmed via direct run. WMS-15's new PanelRuntimeFlowConfirmationTextTest: confirmed correct via the real run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 assembled-app path (RuntimeHost coverage exactly at its floor; the gate's own failure traced to two unrelated pre-existing kernel/NPDevCli coverage-ratchet drops, not this test). validate-corpus.py: confirmed clean (66/66) after removing this session's own contaminating scratch app. Full run-all-gates.ps1 -IncludeReleaseGate -IncludePaperwork NOT re-run end-to-end after fixes (~15+ min cost); each fix verified narrowly instead. Browser demo of all three B28 reload behaviors: PASSED live via ScrapForAI against an ad hoc app, since deleted along with its throwaway routine file.
